title: Parameter slides between trigs (SLIDE on the RTRG page)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: not yet run on a unit. SLIDE (TRIG page 2, RTRG, knob E): when a note's gate goes off, the track's continuous parameters glide in a straight line to the values the next trig sets (its sound with its p-locks), arriving as it plays; no gap, no slide. Per step: SLIDE is p-lockable, a lock on a trig says whether the slide into it happens, a trig without one follows its sound's SLIDE. Lists, switches and modes change at the trig as before. Saved with the sound and in the pattern's locks under a stored id the stock storage leaves free (a stock OS reads SLIDE as off and drops its locks). Our own code, from a study of OS 1.12 (dn2-cfw notes/T2.9-trig-slides.md).
